info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Access Key Management API
info.description: The Access Key Management API provides the ability to manage access keys in the system, allowing for the secure and efficient control of partner access. This endpoint specifically facilitates the deletion of access keys associated with partners, ensuring that unused or outdated keys can be removed to maintain security. Typical consumers of this API include system administrators and partner integration engineers responsible for maintaining access controls. By utilizing this functionality, organizations can effectively manage their access policies and enhance their security posture.

delete.summary: Delete access key for a specific partner.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete an access key associated with a specific partner identified by the resource ID. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action, as it may affect access to resources tied to this access key.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific access key associated with a partner. It requires a JSON payload that adheres to the specified schema to confirm the deletion operation.

204.description: Successfully deleted the resource with no content returned.
